_comment: Minimum tests that must EXECUTE per project. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; never lower one to make a run pass. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole, and verify-test-run checks that sum on every invocation.
